sections.title: American Art Seminar: Collecting American Art
sections.description: This seminar focuses on special topics in the art of the United States. Recent examples have included: portraiture in the US, Philadelphia as an art center, early mass visual culture, and Abstract Expressionism.

sections.title: American Art Seminar: Art in Philadelphia in the 19th Century
sections.description: This seminar focuses on special topics in the art of the United States. Recent examples have included: portraiture in the US, Philadelphia as an art center, early mass visual culture, and Abstract Expressionism. It is open to all graduate students and undergraduate students with permission of the instructor.
